data.body: Leaf 8b08 final validation complete. Execution-phase review PASS after updating the durable plan to the packaged-Python architecture. All three public surfaces and all pip/Homebrew/MCP install shapes are covered; provider MODE and direct legacy reconcile behavior remain compatible. Final gates: lint, typecheck, config-check, lock check, diff check, and 65-test held-out suite green. Review advisories dispositioned on the leaf; no residual gap remains. Next: commit with DCO/ticket/Change-Id, refresh from origin/main immediately before Gerrit push, then drive both votes and submit.
